reportedIssues: The promo badge on the pizza card reads '-0%', which communicates no discount at all — almost certainly a data/formatting bug (null or zero discount rendered instead of being hidden).

In the 'Fastest near you' carousel the third card is hard-clipped at the screen edge and its title 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut mid-word with no ellipsis, so it reads as broken text rather than an intentional peek of the next item.

The favourite (heart) button on the second 'Popular right now' card uses a dark/translucent circle with a dark outline heart, whereas the card above uses a white circle with a dark heart. The dark-on-dark variant has very poor contrast against the pizza image and looks unintentional.

The 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail has a light grey background while the adjacent thumbnails are dark, making the row look visually inconsistent; the white '15–25 min' badge also has weak contrast on that light image.
The second popular card is cut off by the bottom tab bar with no visible fade or spacing, so its title/rating row is hidden behind the navigation and the card appears amputated.
The category chip row is clipped mid-chip on the right edge with no scroll indicator, and the 'See all' links plus icon-only buttons (bell, hearts) have no visible text labels for screen readers.

expected.reasoning: Reported issue 0 identifies the promo badge displaying '-0%', matching the expected discount badge defect.
